about.name: Autonomous AI Text Agents and Text-First Lead Response

mainEntity.name: What is an AI text agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI text agent is an autonomous conversational system that receives, understands, and replies to customer text messages on your business's behalf. Unlike an autoresponder, it holds multi-turn conversations, remembers context, qualifies leads, and books appointments — in seconds, around the clock.

mainEntity.name: How fast should a business respond to a text message?

acceptedAnswer.text: Within minutes — ideally under five. MIT/Harvard research shows leads contacted within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to be qualified than those contacted after 30 minutes. The average business takes 47 hours, which is effectively a forfeit.

mainEntity.name: Do customers really prefer texting over calling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Roughly 90% of consumers say they'd rather text a business than call, and 53% call SMS their preferred communication channel. Meanwhile, about 80% of people don't answer calls from unknown numbers — the channels most businesses rely on are the ones customers avoid.

mainEntity.name: Can an AI text agent actually book appointments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. It checks your live calendar, offers available slots, books the appointment, and sends confirmations and reminders. SMS reminders alone reduce missed appointments by roughly 80%.

mainEntity.name: Do AI text agents work after hours?

acceptedAnswer.text: That's their whole point. AI text agents run 24/7, and 52% of all sales leads arrive outside business hours. Businesses using AI capture dramatically more of those after-hours conversations than voicemail-reliant competitors.

mainEntity.name: What does a missed text message cost a small business?

acceptedAnswer.text: At a $300–$900 average ticket, every unanswered textable inquiry is a conversation handed to a competitor. With 1,000+ textable inquiries a year at typical volumes, slow or missing text response quietly costs Metro Detroit businesses tens of thousands of dollars annually.

mainEntity.name: Will an AI text agent replace my team?

acceptedAnswer.text: No — it handles the routine 80%: first response, qualification, FAQs, booking. Complex or sensitive conversations escalate to your team mid-thread with full context. Your people do the high-value work; the agent does the repetition.

mainEntity.name: How do AI text agents integrate with existing systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: They plug into your CRM, calendar, and dispatch workflows. Every conversation is logged to the contact record, triggers automations, and updates deal stages — no fragmented threads, no lost details.
